entries.en: Lookin' for a pick-me-up. Got any ChroManticore?
entries.ro: Caut ceva să mă revigorez. Ai ChroManticore?

entries.en: Boy, do I, chief! What don't I have? Wouldn't touch that stuff myself, but hey, hey, customer is king, am I right?
entries.ro: Băiete, și încă cum, șefule! Ce nu am? Nu m-aș atinge eu de chestia aia, dar hei, hei, clientul e rege, nu?

entries.en: What is that smell? Is that fruit...? Or wait... dish soap?
entries.en_m: What's that smell? Is that fruit...? Or wait... dish soap?
entries.ro: Ce miros e ăsta? E fruct...? Sau așteaptă... săpun de vase?

entries.en: Ah, speciality of the house! My little apricot surprise! When she ferments right, she's actually a local favorite.
entries.ro: Ei, specialitatea casei! Surpriza mea cu caise! Când fermentează cum trebuie, e favorita localnicilor.
